name: Bogdan Ferreira-Olamide
description: A Ukrainian-Yoruba bare-knuckle fighter from the Gray Zone's Ward Seven who competed in the BLOODWORK CIRCUIT for nine years under the pseudonym 'Saltwall' before his identity was exposed by a Meridian Wire investigation in 2198, at which point he had accumulated a 71-4 record and a following that spanned from Tier 1 devotees to Tier 3 collectors who purchased illegal feed streams of his fights. His augmentation profile was a patchwork of salvaged, non-standardized chrome — a mismatched left forearm from a scrapped industrial unit, a cracked optical enhancer held in place with adhesive sealant — and his survival of nine years in the circuit is considered by the Gray Zone residents a more impressive feat than any corporate-league championship. He now works as a trainer in a Tier 2 gym and has never confirmed or denied the rumors that he still fights under a new pseudonym.
story_hooks: A detective is asked to find a missing Tier 2 teenager who idolized 'Saltwall' and followed rumors of his continued fighting into a BLOODWORK venue that has since gone dark — along with everyone inside it.

Ferreira-Olamide is approached by a corponation talent scout who wants to legitimize him retroactively as a marketing asset for a new underground-aesthetic combat brand, and the offer includes enough Φ to buy his family out of the Gray Zone — at a cost he hasn't yet read the fine print on.

One of the two families of fighters who died in bouts against him has hired a gray-market investigator to build a case, and the investigator's trail leads through the BLOODWORK network to a corponation-linked fight promoter who has been quietly profiting from the Gray Zone deaths for decades.
